PENGUIN SLALOM - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run PenguinSlalom.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
Left / Right steer between the red and blue flags on a downhill snow slope.
Collect fish in the centre of the gates; close passes build a style multiplier.
Missing a gate or striking a pole ends your run immediately. Speed increases
smoothly from 3.3 to 4.7 pixels per frame, starting near the old 1,000-point pace.
Gates have varied widths and spacing,
with narrower openings further down the slope. Dodge snowy rocks, trees, holes
and sideways-trotting mountain goats between gates. Polar bears slide down
from above, overtake the penguins and leave below the screen. Striking an
obstacle ends your run.
The title displays your actual starting position.
Controls: LEFT / RIGHT keyboard arrows; P2: A / D.
X / Z / C / V or a gamepad face button starts from the title; natural directions also start.
Enter starts, pauses and resumes. Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause.
After results, X / gamepad A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
P2 keyboard: H joins, G leaves, T Start, R Select. Up to four gamepads work.
All players share one course and camera at the same downhill speed, with
staggered positions and distinct scarf colours. Penguins do not collide.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Best scores are saved to penguinslalom.srm next to the executable.
